content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: each Save on the cap / floor form is followed by a visible error, and each Notional re-visit comes right after that error is dismissed with OK or a click on the same dialog spot (app:39 then OK at 322 then focus Notional at 330; app:46 then click at 371 then focus Notional at 379), so the form appears to return to Notional after a save-time error.", "fix": "Fix: On the cap / floor form, make the Save validation error name the failing field and show it inline under the Notional input, and have the error dialog's OK handler move focus to that input, so the user does not need to re-find Notional after each dismissal.", "cited_event_ids": ["app:39", "322", "330", "app:46", "371", "379"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The error events carry no label or message, so it is not confirmed that the visible error refers to Notional.", "A visible error also appears when focus moves to Counterparty (63:a63 at 3074, 277:a297 at 12256), so the error source is ambiguous.", "The Notional input values are masked and were not checked; no claim is made about what was typed.", "The first Notional visit (83) follows no Save, so the save-error cycle explains only the two later re-visits.", "No abandonment or lost time was observed, so impact beyond the extra visits cannot be measured."]}
